01 / BRAND IDENTITY

SONOR

An independent audio brand, built around the feeling of being completely absorbed in sound.

STRATEGY · DESIGN · ART DIRECTION2026SELF-INITIATED CONCEPT

The idea.

The identity starts with a simple tension: technical precision and emotional depth. A burgundy palette, confident typography and considered packaging give the brand a presence that feels intimate and expressive. Every touchpoint is designed to make listening feel like a ritual.
